programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.sub_title: Beyond The Readings: It's All Relative
programs.desc: Family is Theresa's cornerstone, which is why connecting people to their loved ones is her life's mission. In a reading she's never shared before, Theresa delivers healing messages to her son's friend.

programs.title: Robin Roberts Presents I Will Survive: The Gloria Gaynor Story
programs.desc: The film chronicles Gaynor's rise to fame, from her humble beginnings to becoming one of the most iconic voices in music history. The biopic will also delve into the personal challenges Gaynor faced.

programs.title: Zombie House Flipping
programs.desc: Keith takes the team to see a house in the Wadeview Park neighbourhood that he's been chasing for two years due to probate issues. In Keith's mind, it's been time well-spent because of the low price.

programs.title: Ppang Car Road 2
programs.desc: From Seoul to Busan, this spectacular eating show takes place at famous bakeries/patisseries to give the dessert lovers the glimpse of tasty goodness of some of the most-coveted desserts of all.

programs.title: Hit-And-Miss Tour
programs.desc: Before heading out, the team gathers to decide who will be the dokbakja for the accommodation. But where's Dahee? In his absence, the group sets up a buffering rock-paper-scissors show in his honour.

programs.title: Hit-And-Miss Tour
programs.desc: The Dokbakz arrive at one of the top attractions in Vang Vien, where travellers from all over the world gather: the Blue Lagoon, with its emerald-clear waters.
